findings.description: In the sunset wide shot the waitress was alone at the counter (01:50-01:51). From ~01:52 to ~01:56 two women with identical appearance (light-blue polo, white apron, hair bun) are on screen at once: one walks behind the counter in the foreground near the coffee machine while a second one materialises at the far end of the counter wiping it. No second employee was established anywhere in the video; the character is duplicated, and one copy later vanishes (~01:57).

In the wide shot (01:21-01:26.75) the waitress sits on the stool beyond the man, deeper into the room, i.e. on his left as both face the counter. At the cut to the close two-shot (01:26.79) both still face the counter with the windows behind them, but the waitress is now on the man's right side (screen-left, further from camera while he is nearer). Handedness of their seating arrangement swapped with no movement.

At 00:27 he sits on the near-end stool (close to camera, lower left of frame) facing screen-right toward the waitress across the counter. After a ~4 s food insert, the same wide angle at 00:36 shows him much further along the counter at its bend, turned to face the camera with the counter/plate between him and the lens, and the waitress gone. At 01:00 in a matching wide he is back on the near-end stool facing right. The reposition and 90-degree change of facing are never shown and contradict his adjacent placements.

Up to 01:50.167 she is seated at a window booth (booth back and condiment bottles on the window table beside her) watching the truck. At 01:50.208, with no elapsed time, she is seated on a counter stool in the middle of the room with a mug in front of her, far from the windows.
